arxiv-2102-01495.title: Deep Learning based Joint Precoder Design and Antenna Selection for Partially Connected Hybrid Massive MIMO Systems
arxiv-2102-01495.creator: Salman Khalid, Waqas bin Abbas, Farhan Khalid, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2102-01495.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Salman Khalid, Waqas bin Abbas, Farhan Khalid, Member, IEEE. Efficient resource allocation with hybrid precoder design is essential for massive MIMO systems operating in millimeter wave (mmW) domain. Owing to a higher energy efficiency and a lower complexity of a partially connected hybrid architecture, in this letter, we propose a joint deep convolutional neural network (CNN) based scheme for precoder design and antenna selection of a partially connected massive MIMO hybrid system.

arxiv-2103-01595.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Henna Koivusalo, Lingmin Liao, Tomas Persson. arxiv-2207-13890.title: Why Accuracy Is Not Enough: The Need for Consistency in Object Detection Journal: Multimedia
arxiv-2207-13890.creator: Caleb Tung, Abhinav Goel, Fischer Bordwell, Nick Eliopoulos, Xiao Hu, Yung-Hsiang Lu, George K. Thiruvathukal
arxiv-2207-13890.description: Abstract Object detectors are vital to many modern computer vision applications. However, even state-of-the-art object detectors are not perfect. On two images that look similar to human eyes, the same detector can make different predictions because of small image distortions like camera sensor noise and lighting changes. This problem is called inconsistency.

arxiv-2303-13147.title: Estimates for the Kolmogorov widths of an intersection of two balls in a mixed norm
arxiv-2303-13147.creator: A. A. Vasil’eva
arxiv-2303-13147.description: Abstract Order estimates for the Kolmogorov widths of an intersection of two finite‐dimensional balls in a mixed norm under some conditions on the parameters are obtained. 1 Introduction In this paper, a problem of order estimates for the Kolmogorov widths of an intersection of two finite‐dimensional balls in a mixed norm is studied. First we give necessary definitions and notation.

arxiv-2401-16897.title: Hamiltonian integrable systems in a magnetic field and Symplectic-Haantjes geometry
arxiv-2401-16897.creator: Ondřej Kubů, Daniel Reyes, Piergiulio Tempesta, Giorgio Tondo
arxiv-2401-16897.description: Abstract . We investigate the geometry of classical Hamiltonian systems immersed in a magnetic field in three-dimensional Riemannian configuration spaces. We prove that these systems admit non-trivial symplectic-Haantjes manifolds, which are symplectic manifolds endowed with an algebra of Haantjes (1,1)-tensors.

arxiv-2404-11901.title: Deep and Dynamic Metabolic and Structural Imaging in Living Tissues
arxiv-2404-11901.creator: Kunzan Liu, Honghao Cao, Kasey Shashaty, Li-Yu Yu, Sarah Spitz, Francesca Michela Pramotton, Zhengpeng Wan, Ellen L. Kan, Erin N. Tevonian, Manuel Levy, Eva Lendaro, Roger D. Kamm, Linda G. Griffith, Fan Wang, Tong Qiu, Sixian You
arxiv-2404-11901.description: Abstract Label-free imaging through two-photon autofluorescence (2PAF) of NAD(P)H allows for non-destructive and high-resolution visualization of cellular activities in living systems. However, its application to thick tissues and organoids has been restricted by its limited penetration depth within 300 µm, largely due to tissue scattering at the typical excitation wavelength ( ∼ \sim 750 nm) required for NAD(P)H.

arxiv-2406-08048.title: 3D CBCT CHALLENGE 2024: IMPROVED CONE BEAM CT RECONSTRUCTION USING SWINIR-BASED SINOGRAM AND IMAGE ENHANCEMENT
arxiv-2406-08048.creator: Sasidhar Alavala, Subrahmanyam Gorthi
arxiv-2406-08048.description: Abstract In this paper, we present our approach to the 3D CBCT Challenge 2024, a part of ICASSP SP Grand Challenges 2024. Improvement in Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) reconstruction has been achieved by integrating Swin Image Restoration (SwinIR) based sinogram and image enhancement modules.

arxiv-2511-03541.title: Scalar molecules η b ​ B c − \eta_{b}B_{c}^{-} and η c ​ B c + \eta_{c}B_{c}^{+} with asymmetric quark contents
arxiv-2511-03541.creator: S. S. Agaev, K. Azizi, H. Sundu
arxiv-2511-03541.description: Abstract The hadronic scalar molecules ℳ b \mathcal{M}_{b} and ℳ c \mathcal{M}_{c} with asymmetric quark contents b ​ b ​ b ¯ ​ c ¯ bb\overline{b}\overline{c} and c ​ c ​ c ¯ ​ b ¯ cc\overline{c}\overline{b} are explored by means of the QCD sum rule method. Their masses and current couplings are calculated using the two-point sum rule approach.

arxiv-2511-23099.title: On Computational Aspects of Cores of Ordered Graphs
arxiv-2511-23099.creator: Michal Čertík, Andreas Emil Feldmann, Jaroslav Nešetřil, Paweł Rzążewski
arxiv-2511-23099.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michal Čertík, Andreas Emil Feldmann, Jaroslav Nešetřil, Paweł Rzążewski. An ordered graph is a graph enhanced with a linear order on the vertex set. An ordered graph is a core if it does not have an order-preserving homomorphism to a proper subgraph. We say that H H is the core of G G if (i) H H is a core, (ii) H H is a subgraph of G G , and (iii) G G admits an order-preserving homomorphism to H H .

pmc-11358920.title: Treatment of Plantar Warts with a Nitric-Zinc Complex Solution: A Review of 72 Cases
pmc-11358920.creator: Sara Garcia-Oreja, Francisco Javier Alvaro-Afonso, Paula Vigara-Aranda, Guillermo Paramio-Rodriguez, Diego Leon-Herce, Jose Luis Lazaro-Martinez, Ian N Hampson
pmc-11358920.description: Background: There are multiple conservative treatment options for plantar warts, but none have proven to be universally effective. Nitric acid is often used empirically by podiatrists in the treatment of plantar warts. A novel medical device or topical solution of nitric–zinc complex solution (NZCS) could potentially offer an effective and safe alternative for the targeted treatment of plantar warts.

pmc-11643509.title: A Graphene-Based Bioactive Product with a Non-Immunological Impact on Mononuclear Cell Populations from Healthy Volunteers
pmc-11643509.creator: María del Prado Lavín-López, Mónica Torres-Torresano, Eva María García-Cuesta, Blanca Soler-Palacios, Mercedes Griera, Martín Martínez-Rovira, José Antonio Martínez-Rovira, Diego Rodríguez-Puyol, Sergio de Frutos, Muralidharan Paramsothy
pmc-11643509.description: We previously described GMC, a graphene-based nanomaterial obtained from carbon nanofibers (CNFs), to be biologically compatible and functional for therapeutic purposes. GMC can reduce triglycerides’ content in vitro and in vivo and has other potential bio-functional effects on systemic cells and the potential utility to be used in living systems.

pmc-11649374.title: Handheld portable device for delivering capped silver nanoparticles for antimicrobial applications
pmc-11649374.creator: Kumar Naveen, Sandeep Bose, Chanbasha Basheer, Richard N. Zare, Elumalai Gnanamani
pmc-11649374.description: We describe a simple, cost-effective, green method for producing capped silver nanoparticles (Ag NPs) using a handheld portable mesh nebulizer. The precursor solution containing a 1:1 mixture of silver nitrate (AgNO3) and ligand (glycerol or sodium alginate) was sprayed using the nebulizer.

pmc-11692367.title: TRAJECTORIES OF CHRONIC PAIN AMONG OLDER VETERANS: IDENTIFYING PAIN-WORSENING PREDICTORS VIA MACHINE LEARNING
pmc-11692367.creator: Chiyoung Lee, Yeri Kim, Seoyoung Kim, Beth Cohen, kent Kwoh, Hyochol Ahn, Juyoung Park, Heewon Kim
pmc-11692367.description: Chronic pain is a major public health problem affecting approximately 100 million Americans and United States military Veterans, who constitute a particularly vulnerable group. While pain research in Veterans is actively underway, information on the longitudinal course of pain in this population is limited.

pmc-13010563.title: Pediatric burns: Key insights from cohort of 325 patients
pmc-13010563.creator: Atul Parashar, Somesh Thakur, Renu Sharda
pmc-13010563.description: BACKGROUNDBurns are a common cause of morbidity and mortality in children, especially in developing countries like India. Unless fatal, burns can lead to lifelong disability, affecting social and psychological well-being of the child. It further exacerbates the financial strain on parents and adversely impacts the mental well-being of siblings.

pmc-13400096.title: Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Direct Oral Anticoagulation
pmc-13400096.creator: Thomas A. Boyle, David J. Callans
pmc-13400096.description: Corresponding Author Before interpreting any stroke prevention trial, clinicians must first decide what stroke and bleeding risks they consider clinically meaningful. Neither statisticians nor regulators can answer that question. Without contextualizing clinically meaningful differences, event rates and noninferiority margins are little more than abstractions. Clinicians who treat atrial fibrillation (AF) have been through this exercise before.

pmc-13425839.title: Point-of-care ultrasound for perioperative deep vein thrombosis assessment in anesthesiology: a narrative review
pmc-13425839.creator: Luis Alberto Rodriguez Linares, Rodrigo Souza da Silva, Marco Antonio Duarte Carneiro
pmc-13425839.description: Although duplex ultrasonography is the diagnostic reference standard, its availability may be limited during busy perioperative periods or in unstable patients who cannot be safely transported.3 These challenges have driven growing interest in point-of-care ultrasound as a rapid bedside method for identifying lower limb thrombosis.

pmc-13565807.title: Enhancing Empathy and Emotional Awareness in Intrapartum Care Through Role-Reversal Simulation: A Mixed-Methods Study with Midwifery Students
pmc-13565807.creator: Yeliz Yıldırım Varışoğlu, Selinay Aktaş Demir, İffet Güler Kaya
pmc-13565807.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Role-reversal simulation significantly improved midwifery students’ emotional availability and responsiveness in intrapartum care.Students reported greater emotional engagement, increased awareness of women’s experiences during labour, and enhanced reflection on their professional roles. What are the implications of the main findings? Experiential and reflective learning supported the development of woman-centred care practices.
